    void
    MethodPAGStmtVisitor.installLambdaCallEdges(AbstractInstanceInvokeExpr expr, Optional<Value> lhs, InvokableStmt stmt, FunctionalObject fo, MethodSignature targetMethodSig)
    Installs the PAG edges of a call that reaches the body of fo (targetMethodSig): the call's arguments go to the parameters / receiver samArgumentIndex(int) names; the result flows to lhs: the body's return value or, for a constructor reference, a fresh object (also bound to the constructor's receiver).
